addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, there are two specific components of the Price Standardization Program implemented, under the Ministry of Domestic Trade and Cost of Living.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: The first is the component mentioned as the Price Standardization Program of Sabah, Sarawak and Labuan.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: If in the expenditure budget book, it is mentioned as Detail 040600.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: This detail refers to the expenditure allocated by the government to cover the cost of transporting goods between ports to ports, port to ports.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: For the year 2024 the allocation provided is as much as RM40 million.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: Another component refers to the Needy Goods Distribution Program, LPG and community drumming, Detail 040500 and for the year 2024 a total of RM225 million has been allocated by the government.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: The Needy Goods Distribution Program, LPG and community drumming has been implemented starting in 2009.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: The objective of this program is to be part of an intervention step to deal with the issue of the big difference in the price of basic goods with price controls in rural areas, compared to other areas.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: This program is implemented to cover the cost of transport carrying seven controlled subsidized goods namely rice, sugar, wheat flour, cooking oil, LPG, petrol, RON95 and diesel, from suppliers to rural areas in six states namely Sabah, Sarawak, Kedah, Kelantan, Terengganu and Pahang so
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: that rural residents can buy the seven items at the control price mentioned earlier, at the same price as the price in nearby cities or towns.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: `` 1020 Overall, this program has successfully controlled the price for the seven items in the affected areas.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: For example, the price for 14 kilogram barrel LPG in the Pensiangan Zone was RM65 per barrel before the implementation of this program,
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: compared to only RM26.60 per barrel sold after the implementation of this program.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: The closest example with Yang Berhormat Tenom for the Tomani Zone and the Melalap Zone for example, the control price of RM26.60.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: Without the control price in the market, the price for this LPG is for Tomani RM38 and for Melalap RM40 per barrel.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: For Sabah alone, this program involves 69 zones with a total of 216 areas
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: and has a direct impact and impact on an estimated more than 525,000 population in the affected areas.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: Good.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]
addressees: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah
Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: Dear Tenom, additional question.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Minister Papar for the enlightenment and explanation answer presented.
edus.speaker: Tuan Riduan bin Rubin [Tenom]

Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: Additional questions, does the ministry plan to create a price standardization mechanism involving subsidized and non-subsidized basic goods in Sabah?
edus.speaker: Tuan Riduan bin Rubin [Tenom]
addressees: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah
Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: Since the price of non-subsidized basic goods in Sabah varies between one district and another, especially in rural areas, to ensure that the price is reasonable, controlled and does not burden the people, especially the community in rural areas.
edus.speaker: Tuan Riduan bin Rubin [Tenom]
addressees: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah
Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Tuan Riduan bin Rubin [Tenom]
addressees: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah
Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: Honorable Minister.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]
addressees: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah
Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: Thank you, Your Honor.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: First, I think we have to accept our basics is that we adapt the free market economy, the free market system
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: where the prices of these items are determined by the market mechanism.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: However, we use a control mechanism for certain items, basic necessities to ensure that our people get access to those items at a reasonable price.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: For that reason, this program is implemented port-to-port
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: and also from the center to POS ( point of sale ) to ensure that residents in rural areas also get access to those control items.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: So, at the current stage, the basics are control items
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: because for your knowledge, financial implications only for this program started in 2009.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: The implications are RM93 million and 2023 and 2024, the cost has already increased to RM225 million.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: So, for now, Your Honor, we focus on control items first.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: The important thing is that we expand the coverage of this zone or point of sale.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: For example, if I may mention in 2019,
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: the point of sale throughout the country involved in this program is 1,601 and in 2024,
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: we will expand to 1,727 points of sale.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: This means that the coverage of the interior is increasing.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: We improve from time to time, Your Honor.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: For example for this program, we find that there are complaints of the leakage of the subsidy.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: For your information, for the first time this year, on May 1, for the first time, procurement through an open tender that uses the e terbuka system was implemented with the appointment of 146 transport companies.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: So Your Honor, I understand Your Honor's concern.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: We are open to suggestions.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: Perhaps Yang Berhormat Tenom feels that there are certain items whose prices are too high in the area of Yang Berhormat, please give us feedback for us to weigh.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: However, I would like to see that for the rural areas in Sabah, Sarawak, let the long-term steps be taken into account.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: For example, what we do in the delivery of cooking oil.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: In the past, Mr. Speaker, these repackers companies, the basics from the Peninsula were raised through port-to-port subsidies to Sabah and Sarawak.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: But now, there is an approach for us to appoint these repackers in Sabah itself
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: and also in Sarawak.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: So, he can reduce the cost of subsidies for repackers and transport companies as a whole.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: So at the KPDN level, I would also like to inform you, Your Honor, I have asked our enforcers, for example in the case of chicken.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: Why is the price of chicken different from Sabah, Sarawak?
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: To get invoices and information from breeders and wholesalers and retailers,
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: what is the real basis for the high price compared to the Peninsula,
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: because when it comes to logistics, I see that even my own area has chicken farms.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: So, what is the logistics issue of the chicken farms and in the end the market price is higher in the town, compared to in Peninsular Malaysia.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: Maybe the issue is the cost of chicken food and so on.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: I hope and KPDN will channel information to the Ministry of Agriculture for us to cooperate with the state governments, especially Sabah and Sarawak for the long term how we can resolve the high price issue in Sabah and Sarawak.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Minister, long and wide.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]
addressees: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah
Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: Good, left.

addressees: Tuan Abdul Latiff bin Abdul Rahman [Kuala Krai]

addressees: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.

addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: I take this opportunity, a request from my friend the Santubong Member of Parliament to welcome the presence of a group from the Santubong Parliament [ Applause ] to be together in the House.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, as I mentioned earlier that our current focus is to look at the control items.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: What was asked earlier, we have increased for example this point of sale area from a total of 1,601, increased for implementation for the year 2024 to 1,727.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]
addressees: Tuan Abdul Latiff bin Abdul Rahman [Kuala Krai]

edus.text: This means that we always make an assessment of any new point of sale area to be included in the coverage of this program.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]
addressees: Tuan Abdul Latiff bin Abdul Rahman [Kuala Krai]

edus.text: I welcome feedback from the Honorable,
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: if there is an area that needs to be considered as one of the points of sale, including in the Honorable area to be included together
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]
addressees: Tuan Abdul Latiff bin Abdul Rahman [Kuala Krai]

edus.text: and the people get access to the goods at the price of the control.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]
addressees: Tuan Abdul Latiff bin Abdul Rahman [Kuala Krai]

edus.text: Second, what was mentioned earlier about the types of goods.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]
addressees: Tuan Abdul Latiff bin Abdul Rahman [Kuala Krai]

edus.text: So far, the seven items and we will take into account based on the existing fiscal space
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]
addressees: Tuan Abdul Latiff bin Abdul Rahman [Kuala Krai]

edus.text: if it can be expanded to other goods.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]
addressees: Tuan Abdul Latiff bin Abdul Rahman [Kuala Krai]

edus.text: Because there are certain areas, Your Honor, thank God, there are certain areas of the point of sale that we consider to have graduated.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]
addressees: Tuan Abdul Latiff bin Abdul Rahman [Kuala Krai]

edus.text: There is already road access and closer supply coverage within the designated radius, maybe we can remove the area in the list
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugastugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]
addressees: Tuan Abdul Latiff bin Abdul Rahman [Kuala Krai]

edus.text: and we can consider including other items in this program.

edus.text: For the information of the Honorable and this honorable House, today is the 25th anniversary of TEKUN,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: which was established on November 9, 1998.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: The Ministry of Entrepreneur Development and Cooperatives through TEKUN Nasional, plays a role in helping micro entrepreneurs
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: by providing business capital through capital financing.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: cumulatively, the total funding of TEKUN Nasional since its establishment in 1998 amounted to RM8.98 billion.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: For the year 2023,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: which is until October 31, 2023, as much as RM922.6 million or 42,383 financing has been approved from that amount, which is as much as RM467.2 million is the first financing for a total of 26,481 entrepreneurs.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: For information, TEKUN is able to provide this financing
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: because it is the first or the grant through a budget initiative.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: Secondly, TEKUN also collects back loans that we will use to be turned around as capital for new entrepreneurs.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: In an effort to increase the number of entrepreneurs entering the business field, TEKUN has implemented new financing schemes for the year 2023 as follows:
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: ( i ) TEKUN's Online Financing Scheme to 779 entrepreneurs involving financing amounting to RM5.9 million;
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: ( ii ) Tamu Entrepreneur Financing Scheme to 581 entrepreneurs involving financing amounting to RM2.6 million;
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: ( iii ) Craft Entrepreneur Financing Scheme to 11 entrepreneurs involving financing amounting to RM296 thousand;
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: and ( iv ) TEKUN Mobilepreneur Program to 731 entrepreneurs involving financing amounting to RM6 million.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: In addition, TEKUN Nasional has also participated in exhibitions and entrepreneur programs held by ministries and agencies under the ministry such as the One District One Industry showcase, PMKS week to give a direct explanation about TEKUN's financing schemes
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: and in addition we also bring TEKUN entrepreneurs to sell.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: TEKUN also promotes financing schemes through TEKUN's website, government radio television channel, state radios and official social media.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: Regarding the proposal for TEKUN Nasional to implement the Startup program for entrepreneurs who have just started their business,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: TEKUN Nasional has offered the TEKUN Niaga Financing Scheme
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: which provides small business capital facilities with a financing value of between RM1,000 to RM100,000 to all micro entrepreneurs, including for start-up entrepreneurs or Startup entrepreneurs.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: Thank you.

edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: For your information, the Malaysian Ministry of Education realizes that there is a access disruption to the Identity Management System ( idMe ) and the MoE Integrated System ( MOEIS ).
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: The MoE detected the disruption starting on 19 January 2023 due to technical issues and system use issues.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: The issue was resolved on 11 February 2023.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: The system's performance continues to be monitored to ensure that it is always operating well to minimize access disruptions.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: The MoE has identified the root of the problem to the entire system taking into account the overall system management as well as competency personnel to further strengthen the implementation of the system.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: As of 16 March 2023 Your Honor, a total of 89 percent of schools across the country have finished including data in the Integrated Assessment Management System under MOEIS through idMe.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: While the rest have the option to include data either through this management system or offline.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: Despite being given the option, there are three states that use the Integrated Assessment Management System ( SPPB ) 100 percent, namely the states of Kelantan, Sarawak and the Federal Territory of Labuan.

edus.text: While the state of Perlis reached 99 percent of the filling into the system.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [ Kuching City ] ask the Minister of Health to state the amount spent on dealing with non-communicable diseases ( NCDs ), especially diabetes, and planning to address the high prevalence of NCD in our country.
edus.speaker: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: Honorable Minister.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker,
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: thank you Honorable Bandar Kuching.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: Alhamdulillah, this is a very good question for me and we also have the Minister of Economy here to hear the figures we use - so high in the Malaysian Ministry of Health related to this NCD.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]
Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, a study from the National Health and Morbidity Survey 2019 found that 50 percent of Malaysians suffer from at least one non-communicable disease
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: which is NCD.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: This includes high blood pressure,
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: diabetes and also high cholesterol or hypercholesterolemia.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Malaysia's diabetes or diabetes mellitus prevalence is the highest in Southeast Asia Mr. Speaker, where the country recorded a significant increase from 11.2 hundreds in 2011 to 18.3 percent in 2019 which shows one in two cases of diabetes prevalence.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Diabetes causes various complications to sufferers.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: So, a diabetes sufferer is at risk of heart disease - stroke, nerve damage - eyes
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: and also kidney failure, and many more.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: The Strategic Plan Report Reduces the Beban of Chronic Kidney Disease found that 65 percent of patients who need dialysis treatment are from among those who suffer from diabetes.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: The total direct health care expenditure to deal with this non-communicable disease - the Minister of Economy, is as much as RM9.65 billion
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: covering 16.8 percent of the total health expenditure in Malaysia.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: This estimate was made based on expenses in 2017
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]
Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: and a report was issued in 2022 through The Direct Healthcare Cost of Non-communicable Diseases in Malaysia by the World Health Organization.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]
Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, I beg - I will continue.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: The total expenditure for diabetes is as much as RM4.38 billion
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]
Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: which is 45.38 percent of the total expenditure of NCD diseases.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Followed by expenses to treat cardiovascular as much as RM3.93 billion
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: which is 40.73 percent and RM1.34 billion
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: which is 13.89 percent to treat cancer.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: This expenditure includes hospitalization, primary care in health clinics
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: and also outpatient treatment in hospitals and examinations
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: and also health tests and medical financing.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: For 2017, NCD has had a negative impact on the economy
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: where the indirect or indirect cost
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: as a result of this NCD is as much as RM12.88 billion in the form of loss of productivity.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Diabetes mellitus recorded a loss of productivity of up to RM5.74 billion and cardiovascular as much as RM5.32 billion.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, may I continue a little more? ...
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Please.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: So, in order to deal with the prevalence of NCD with such a high impact on the economy, the ministry implemented several initiatives including empowering the implementation of a comprehensive plan
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: called the National Strategic Plan for NCD Diseases 2016-2025.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Then we also implemented this National Builder's Healthy Community Program for community-empowerment which - with the permission of the President, we do a lot with the communities to ensure,
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: or to encourage the culture of a healthy way of life.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Some of what we set up are KOSPEN involving volunteers throughout the country.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Right now we have a total of 6,567 volunteers.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: We also carry out advocacy, which is to carry out advocacy activities
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: and this is carried out through various mediums that are carried out continuously at the community level as well.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Then, we also strengthen health screening activities.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: This one, that's why I ask all Members of the Legislative Assembly to make sure to go and do the screening.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: I can tell that there are still those who have not yet done health screening and please let us avoid anyone who has the disease facing bad complications.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: Then, we also have promotional activities from the Healthy Malaysia National Agenda that we implement in 10 years, 2020 to 2030.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]
Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: This one we take a whole-of-nation approach
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: involving educational institutions, workplaces, communities and also health facilities.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Lastly, we raise excise duty on sugary drinks, or ready to drink,
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: where we have started excise duty taxes on sugary drinks or sugar-sweeten drinks since 2019 at a rate of RM0.40 cents per liter.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: As the Prime Minister's announcement in Budget 2024, last October 13, the government has increased the rate to 50 cents per liter.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: So, as the Prime Minister's announcement, the proceeds of this excise duty will be channeled back to the Malaysian Ministry of Health for the purpose of dealing with and treating diabetes including support for hemodialysis centers.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: The Ministry welcomes and is very grateful to the Prime Minister for this announcement as well as the government's concern and commitment in supporting the ministry's efforts to deal with the problem of non-communicable diseases in Malaysia, especially diabetes.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Additional question Dear City of Kuching.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Thank you Minister for the very detailed answer earlier.
edus.speaker: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: Yesterday we heard a report that there were several schools getting bomb threats.
edus.speaker: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: We understand that it's a hoax,
edus.speaker: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: but this threat is not a hoax.
edus.speaker: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.speaker: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: If it's not handled properly,
edus.speaker: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: it will explode
edus.speaker: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.speaker: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: I want to ask, what next efforts will the Ministry of Health take to raise public awareness of the dangers of excessive sugar consumption.
edus.speaker: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: We know that our diabetes rate is very high.
edus.speaker: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: In fact, we are the sweetest nation in Asia
edus.speaker: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: but we should not be proud of the statistics.
edus.speaker: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: Ask for answers.
edus.speaker: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: That's it, thank you.
edus.speaker: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: Honorable Minister.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Thank you, Your Honor.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: So, to answer that question, I actually want to say that the Malaysian Ministry of Health will launch a plan that we call the Sugar Advocacy Plan in the near future,
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: God willing.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: This is an effort to deal with non-communicable diseases, especially diabetes or diabetics.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: We actually cover all ages, Your Honor,
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: and we start at the childhood level, in preschool, also in primary schools and also IPTA and IPTS.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: Adults are of course, in workplaces and also seniors.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: We involve NGOs as well, parental associations, village heads, also DUN offices and also Parliament offices.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]

edus.text: So, I also request cooperation from all Members of Parliament
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: so that we can make our country less sweet.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: Less sweet.

edus.text: Tuan Roslan bin Hashim asked the Minister of Entrepreneur Development and Cooperatives to state the number of entrepreneurs who go out of business due to the current economic slowdown and what the ministry's efforts to help entrepreneurs are affected.

edus.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker.

addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: For the information of the Honorable Members and this honorable House, based on a survey
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: that has been carried out by the Ministry of Entrepreneur Development and Cooperatives or simply KUSKOP from 2020 to 2023,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: the effects of the COVID-19 pandemic and the increase in the price of goods are seen to cause a small number of entrepreneurs to continue to close their business operations.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: Based on the survey as well, the percentage of entrepreneurs
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: who go out of business in 2020 to 2022 is as follows: ( i ) 8.85 percent in April 2020;
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: ( ii ) 3.06 percent in June 2021;
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: ( iii ) 1.38 percent in February 2022;
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: and ( iv ) 2.07 percent in November 2022.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: This is based on the survey that has been done by my ministry.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: In an effort to help affected entrepreneurs, KUSKOP through the agencies under it, has implemented several initiatives
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: to restore their business with the following actions.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: First, provide financial loan assistance such as financing schemes under TEKUN Nasional and Ikhtiar Financing Scheme under Amanah Ikhtiar Malaysia.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: Funding agencies under KUSKOP have also simplified the application process by reducing the necessary documentation and shortening the time period to process applications;
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: `` 1020 Second, the ministry and agencies under the ministry work with the Credit Counseling and Management Agency ( AKPK ) for the implementation of a second opportunity intervention program to help entrepreneurs who are facing serious financial management problems
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: and are at risk of bankruptcy.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: In 2022, a total of 664 entrepreneurs were given awareness about the availability of second opportunities through various initiatives provided by the government.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: Of these, a total of 40 entrepreneurs were selected to participate in the INSKEN Special Guidance Program for four months starting on 17 October 2022.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: Third, SME Corp has also signed a Memorandum of Understanding with AKPK on 3 February 2023 as an effort
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: to help PMKS in financial and credit education and management.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: This strategic collaboration is seen to be able to help
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: and make it easier for PMKS to make decisions in managing finances wisely and prudently, especially after the era or during the post-pandemic.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: As your information also, this year of the 12 programs that we have implemented specifically to develop new entrepreneurs
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: including the new AIM Entrepreneur Friends, the new TEKUN Entrepreneur program, the franchise improvement program, the Business Basic Guidance Program or Start-Up Coaching, the Dropship and Agent program, the Graduate Mentoring Program, Tunas Usahawan Belia Bumiputera, the Career Training and Entrepreneurship Placement Program for TVET Graduates, the Apprentice Entrepreneur Program among others.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: This year alone we have produced 75,600 new entrepreneurs.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: Thank you, Honorable Minister.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]
addressees: Menteri Ekonomi [Tuan Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli]

edus.text: Honorable members, now the session is over for the Minister's questions today.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Thank you, Your Honor.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Speaker, Motion 36 ( 12 ).
edus.speaker: Dato’ Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Please, Your Honor.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: What is it?
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Thank you, Speaker.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: I, the Hulu Terengganu Member of Parliament sent a letter to the Speaker regarding
edus.speaker: Dato’ Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: referring the Tambun Member of Parliament to the Rights and Freedoms Committee on the 14th of the month,
edus.speaker: Dato’ Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: and I received a reply letter dated the 15th of the month, which gave a letter to Tambun to answer what was said to the PMQ Time answer a few days ago.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: What was raised here is that the Prime Minister stated that the expenditure for government promotion under the leadership of Pagoh and also Bera reached RM700 million
edus.speaker: Dato’ Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: and it contradicts what is true.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: So, I am here, I quote that what Datuk Armizan as Minister of Sabah, Sarawak Affairs and Special Duties answered said
edus.speaker: Dato’ Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: that the expenditure used by Pagoh Members of Parliament was only RM191,752.20 for branding,
edus.speaker: Dato’ Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: including promotional and publicity work and media announcements.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Also answered by the same Minister on May 25, 2023 saying that the Prime Minister or Minister informed
edus.speaker: Dato’ Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: that the latest expenses for the Madani Malaysia Program - I repeat, the latest program for Madani Malaysia was answered by the same Minister on May 25, 2023 amounting to RM7.4 million.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: So, here there is a contradiction.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Okay.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Madani spent RM7.4 million
edus.speaker: Dato’ Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: but it is said that Pagoh and Bera spent RM71 million.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: So, that's why I request that the matter be referred to 36 ( 12 )
edus.speaker: Dato’ Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: to determine which is true
edus.speaker: Dato’ Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: because this actually tarnishes our image, the image of the Opposition in particular, saying that we spend luxury.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: So, until now, the letter sent by the Speaker to Tambun to answer this problem until 21 days of the month which is two, three days - last Tuesday,
edus.speaker: Dato’ Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: but until now, I don't know what the answer is.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: I beg for advice from the Speaker.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Dear Hulu Terengganu, okay.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: There are two perspectives here, yes.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: First of all, what has been raised by the Honorable 'Kuala Terengganu' - oh, Hulu Terengganu.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Sorry, Hulu Terengganu - still under review with the Urus Setia.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: This proposal of the Honorable Hulu Terengganu is still under consideration by the Honorable Tan Sri Speaker and I believe,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Tan Sri Speaker will rise today.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Can be resurrected.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: In his consideration, yes.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: The question is, I don't know
edus.speaker: Dato’ Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: if the answer has arrived yet because of his 'death' date or due time on November 21st.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: That's to know, whether it's answered or not.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Yes, that's what I mean.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: That's what ...
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Because, as Prime Minister I don't think it's appropriate to mislead the House, insult the House with the amount I feel is inappropriate.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Good.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Your Honor ...
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: So, that's what the Chief Minister of Kedah said.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Open your mouth, lie.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Open your mouth, lie.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Rosol bin Wahid [Hulu Terengganu]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: The Honorable Hulu Terengganu point has been taken into account and I, who presided over this morning, have stated that this matter has been under consideration by the Honorable Tan Sri Speaker himself,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: and today, he will go up
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: and the Honorable can ask in this open House.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Good.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]
Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Only, I want to ask,
edus.speaker: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: will Tan Sri Tuan Yang di-Pertua go up after this?
edus.speaker: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Follow the schedule, he has gone up today.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]
addressees: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]

edus.text: Yes.
edus.speaker: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: I want to ask him.
edus.speaker: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: I am more suitable like that.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]
addressees: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]

edus.text: So, the rules of the other Council can run as arranged.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]
addressees: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]

edus.text: Otherwise, we will take time and space for the other rules to be stuck, yes.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]
addressees: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]

edus.text: In such a way, Tan Sri Speaker will rise.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]
addressees: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]

edus.text: That is more suitable.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]
addressees: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]

edus.text: You get, with permission, the word from the mouth of the House itself, yes.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]
addressees: Dato' Sri Saifuddin bin Abdullah [Indera Mahkota]

edus.text: Dato' Deputy Speaker, I would like to raise the point of order 36 ( 6 ).
edus.speaker: Dr. Mohammed Taufiq bin Johari [Sungai Petani]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: What was mentioned by Hulu Terengganu earlier, that this decision is not yet available
edus.speaker: Dr. Mohammed Taufiq bin Johari [Sungai Petani]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: but Hulu Terengganu has thrown,
edus.speaker: Dr. Mohammed Taufiq bin Johari [Sungai Petani]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: as if His Excellency Tambun misled the House,
edus.speaker: Dr. Mohammed Taufiq bin Johari [Sungai Petani]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: insulted the House -
edus.speaker: Dr. Mohammed Taufiq bin Johari [Sungai Petani]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: and opened his mouth only lies.
edus.speaker: Dr. Mohammed Taufiq bin Johari [Sungai Petani]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: That is a bad assumption
edus.speaker: Dr. Mohammed Taufiq bin Johari [Sungai Petani]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: and I beg you.
edus.speaker: Dr. Mohammed Taufiq bin Johari [Sungai Petani]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Don't run,
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Onn bin Abu Bakar [Batu Pahat]

edus.text: don't run.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Onn bin Abu Bakar [Batu Pahat]

edus.text: I beg to withdraw, Honorable Speaker.
edus.speaker: Dr. Mohammed Taufiq bin Johari [Sungai Petani]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Dear Sungai Petani, the issue raised is related to Meeting Rule 36
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]
addressees: Dr. Mohammed Taufiq bin Johari [Sungai Petani]

edus.text: and what has been stated by Hulu Terengganu is related.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]
addressees: Dr. Mohammed Taufiq bin Johari [Sungai Petani]

edus.text: So, there is no bad thought and so on.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]
addressees: Dr. Mohammed Taufiq bin Johari [Sungai Petani]

edus.text: But, I beg to withdraw, Dato `` Deputy Speaker.
edus.speaker: Dr. Mohammed Taufiq bin Johari [Sungai Petani]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Yes.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]
addressees: Dr. Mohammed Taufiq bin Johari [Sungai Petani]

edus.text: As I mentioned earlier, my decision.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]
addressees: Dr. Mohammed Taufiq bin Johari [Sungai Petani]

edus.text: If he doesn't speak,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]
addressees: Dr. Mohammed Taufiq bin Johari [Sungai Petani]

edus.text: I who presides over this don't know what the details are.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]
addressees: Dr. Mohammed Taufiq bin Johari [Sungai Petani]

edus.text: But, the word'Lie' , Dato' Speaker for the decision.
edus.speaker: Dr. Mohammed Taufiq bin Johari [Sungai Petani]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Your Honor,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]
addressees: Dr. Mohammed Taufiq bin Johari [Sungai Petani]

edus.text: if from that perspective Your Honor Sungai Petani wants to raise,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]
addressees: Dr. Mohammed Taufiq bin Johari [Sungai Petani]

edus.text: propose one thing.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]
addressees: Dr. Mohammed Taufiq bin Johari [Sungai Petani]

edus.text: Good, Deputy.
edus.speaker: Dr. Mohammed Taufiq bin Johari [Sungai Petani]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: I had to listen to what to say.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]
addressees: Dr. Mohammed Taufiq bin Johari [Sungai Petani]

edus.text: If he brings up the matter, in my consideration, there is no perspective meant by Yang Berhormat Sungai Petani, suggest.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]
addressees: Dr. Mohammed Taufiq bin Johari [Sungai Petani]

edus.text: Good, yes.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]
addressees: Dr. Mohammed Taufiq bin Johari [Sungai Petani]
